summary: Iteration 16: tested the new graduation snipe system (graduation_monitor.py, graduation_executor.py, 5 new endpoints, /api/live/emergency_stop kill switch, GraduationPanel.jsx). Created /app/backend/tests/test_graduation_it16.py: 28/28 passed — module constants, monitor disabled-start no-op + status shape, 8 executor fail-closed safety gates (exec disabled, live_trader not ready, low_liquidity, daily budget, max_concurrent, cooldown, per-source disable, status defaults) with live_trader.execute_swap and jupiter.get_quote booby-trapped to raise AssertionError (never invoked; buys_fired stayed 0 in every case), all 5 graduation endpoints incl. source filter + replay invalid sig/source, emergency_stop kill switch (verified executor.enabled=false and pumpfun autobuy enabled=false afterwards), and a 10-endpoint regression sweep (all 200). Frontend: Dashboard loads, graduation-panel visible, Monitor: OFF / Executor: SAFE badges, all 6 stat tiles, both empty-state lists, pumpfun-panel + live-trading-panel regression OK, 0 console errors, Emergency Stop button click -> 200 + 'stopped: live_trader, pumpfun_autobuy, graduation_executor' message. No live gates were enabled at any point.

minor.issue: No concurrency guard: max_concurrent / cooldown / daily-budget are all checked BEFORE `await asyncio.sleep(settle_delay_sec)` and last_buy_at/day_spent_sol are only mutated AFTER execute_swap. Two graduations detected in the same ~3s window (monitor dispatches each via asyncio.create_task) can both pass the gates and both buy, exceeding max_concurrent and the daily budget. Suggest reserving a slot + budget (or an asyncio.Lock) before the settle sleep.

cfg.enabled is not re-checked after the settle delay, so POST /api/live/emergency_stop fired during the 3s settle window will not stop an in-flight buy. Add a post-sleep `if not self.cfg.enabled: return` guard.
reserves_sol liquidity filter uses the detection-time snapshot only; no re-read after the 3s settle, so a pool drained during settle still gets bought.

Kill switch flips config flags only; it does not cancel the graduation monitor WSS tasks, the position loop, or force-close open graduation positions. Also unauthenticated (acknowledged fast-path choice) — add a shared-secret header before public exposure.
rejects_filter is incremented only for the low_liquidity branch; gate rejects (cooldown/budget/max_concurrent) are invisible in counters, making dashboard triage harder.

Graduation buys skip the pump.fun anti-rug suite (mint/freeze authority, dev-hold, holder concentration) that pumpfun_autobuy enforces; only live_trader's generic gates apply. Confirm this is intentional for post-graduation mints.
Errors are swallowed into 200 responses with an `error` key instead of 5xx; acceptable for dashboard use but hides failures from monitoring.

action_items: Add a concurrency/budget reservation (asyncio.Lock or pre-reserve slot+budget) before the settle-delay sleep in graduation_executor.on_event
Re-check cfg.enabled (and optionally re-check pool liquidity) after the settle delay so emergency_stop is honored mid-flight
Optionally make emergency_stop also cancel monitor/position tasks and count non-liquidity rejects
critical_code_review_comments: graduation_executor.on_event: gates evaluated pre-sleep + counters mutated post-swap = TOCTOU window on real money; guard with a lock and reserve day_spent_sol/positions slot before awaiting the settle delay.
graduation_monitor dispatches on_event via asyncio.create_task with no bounded concurrency, which is what makes the above race reachable.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — executor gate tests used in-memory fake DB collections; no MongoDB writes.

rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. Only latent risk: graduation_executor.on_event performs all budget/concurrency/cooldown checks before `await asyncio.sleep(settle_delay_sec)` while last_buy_at and day_spent_sol are updated only after execute_swap, so concurrent graduation events dispatched by the monitor can each pass the gates and double-spend.
